tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search real-time physical retail store inventories near a shopper’s GPS location. Returns verified brick-and-mortar stores, in-stock products, unit prices, and Haversine distance in kilometers.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Reserve in-stock items at a local physical store and generate a zero-PII, non-custodial checkout URL. The shopper completes payment and delivery details directly on the verified merchant checkout page.

tools.name: check_order_status
tools.description: Check live fulfillment, payment, and courier dispatch status for an existing local retail order.

tools.name: report_store
tools.description: Submit an autonomous trust-and-safety violation report if a store exhibits deceptive pricing, phantom stock, or invalid coordinates.
